name: FlightCheck - Alert Engine
description: Analyzes today's flight prices against historical data, detects new all-time lows and significant drops (20%+ below 30-day avg), and sends alerts to Discord.

parameters.query: SELECT destination_iata, destination_name, price, stops, layover_airport, departure_date, flight_duration FROM flight_prices WHERE run_date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY destination_iata, price

SELECT (SELECT MIN(price) FROM flight_prices WHERE destination_iata = '{{ $json.destination_iata }}' AND run_date < CURRENT_DATE) as all_time_low, (SELECT AVG(price) FROM flight_prices WHERE destination_iata = '{{ $json.destination_iata }}' AND run_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND run_date < CURRENT_DATE) as avg_30d
